create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure a fairchem job with run name, device type, and scheduler settings
create_scheduler_config: create a SchedulerConfig dataclass to configure local or SLURM scheduling with node and array job counts
create_slurm_config: create a SlurmConfig dataclass to configure SLURM job parameters like memory, timeout, and CPUs per task
use_scheduler_type_enum: use the SchedulerType enum to select between local and SLURM scheduling modes for job execution
use_device_type_enum: use the DeviceType enum to select between CPU and CUDA device types for fairchem job runs
